parts.name: Switch (Right Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right handle switch of the faucet, made of stainless steel, used to control water flow or temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn on/off or adjust the water flow by rotating the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis to open or close the valve mechanism.

parts.name: Switch (Left Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left handle switch of the faucet, made of stainless steel, used to control water flow or temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to control the water flow or temperature by rotating the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis to open or close the valve mechanism.

parts.name: Frame (Body)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body or frame of the faucet, made of brass, providing structural support and housing for internal water channels.
parts.Functional_description: It connects the spout and switches, channels water from the inlet to the outlet, and supports the entire faucet assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed base for other moving parts.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet, made of stainless steel, through which water exits the fixture.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the flow of water from the faucet body to the sink.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel or remain fixed depending on the faucet design.
